title: nTransactions v5.1 / Android APK v4.2 Major Release
message: Major release introducing features from the past 3 months including Transfer record editing, AI tools integration, flicker-free search, and automated loan reminders.
changelog: Android App version upgraded from v3.0 to v4.2
PWA Web App version upgraded from v4.0 to v5.1 (September 2026)
Transfer Record Editing — Direct editing support for internal wallet transfers
Flicker-free Instant Search — Optimized record filtering with 35ms debouncing
AI Financial Assistant & MCP Integration — MCP server tools for Claude Desktop, Manus, and Grok AI
Smart Loan Due Reminders — Automated push notifications for loan due dates and overdue payments
Monthly Digest & Email Reports — Multipart HTML & plain text monthly financial summary emails
Persistent SMS Notification Sync — Read/unread state synchronization across native app and Firebase
Wallet Balance & Real-time Sync Engine — Fixed wallet calculation and tombstone sync logic
